Definition: Mikajah, the name of three Israelites
BiblicalUsage: Micah or Micaiah or Michaiah = "who is like God"; 1) an Ephraimite during the period of the judges; 2) son of Imlah and a prophet of Samaria who predicted the defeat and death of king Ahab of Israel; 3) son of Gemariah in the time of Jeremiah
